issues.display_title: Issue #67: Implement SEO Slug Routing for Country and City Landing Pages
issues.main_description_html:
Description:

Update routing and navigation links across 360photographers.org to use dedicated SEO-friendly slug paths instead of query parameter URLs (e.g., replace /?country=Canada with /virtual-tour-services-canada). In addition, turn individual city and country text in the photographer profile card into clickable internal links pointing to their respective directory landing pages (e.g., linking city to /virtual-tour-services-toronto and country to /virtual-tour-services-canada).

Demo by developer

issues.display_title: Issue #66: Update Location Label and Format on Photographer Profile View
issues.main_description_html:
Description:

Update the photographer profile page on 360photographers.org to modify the location display format. Remove the continent suffix (e.g., · North America) and replace the default "LOCATION" header label so it formats dynamically as "Google Street View photographer [City], [Country]" (e.g., "Google Street View photographer Toronto, Canada").

issues.display_title: Issue #71: Confirm with PM: Location row on photographer profile — #66 wording vs #67 city/country links
issues.main_description_html:
Related: #66, #67 (#68 / PR #70, #69).

Context

Two issues change the same Location row on /photographer/[slug]:

  • #66 replaces the value with "Google Street View photographer Toronto, Canada", drops the continent (· North America), and says the "Location" label can go (albug: "you can also remove Location").
  • #67 turns the city and country into links: city to /virtual-tour-services-toronto (done in PR #70), country to /virtual-tour-services-canada (#69, not built yet).

Today the row reads LOCATION / Toronto, Canada · North America. After PR #70, Toronto is a link.

Questions for PM

  1. Final text and links. Is it Google Street View photographer Toronto, Canada, with only Toronto and Canada as links? Or should the whole phrase be one link?
  2. "Location" label. Remove it, or keep it above the new text?
  3. Image processing profiles. /image-processing/[slug] has the same Location row. "Google Street View photographer" doesn't fit image processors. Should that page stay as it is, or get different wording?
  4. Missing city. When a profile has no city, should it read Google Street View photographer Canada?
  5. Country link before #69 ships. Should the country stay plain text until /virtual-tour-services-<country> exists, or link to /?country=Canada for now?

Proposed order

Merge PR #70 (city link) first, then build #66 on top of it so the city link survives.

issues.display_title: Issue #68: City landing pages: serve /virtual-tour-services-<city> alongside the old prefix, link city on profiles
issues.main_description_html:
Part of #67.

Description

City landing pages are served only at /360-virtual-tour-photographer-<city> (e.g. /360-virtual-tour-photographer-toronto). The requested URL, /virtual-tour-services-toronto, returns 404 on prod. The city on the photographer profile's Location row is plain text.

Requirements

  1. /virtual-tour-services-<city> renders the same city landing page as /360-virtual-tour-photographer-<city>. Both prefixes keep working, so already-indexed URLs don't break.
  2. /virtual-tour-services-<city> is the canonical URL. The page's <link rel="canonical">, og:url and JSON-LD url point to it on both prefixes, and the sitemap lists it instead of the old prefix.
  3. On /photographer/[slug], the city in the Location row links to /virtual-tour-services-<city>.
  4. Non-ASCII city names (e.g. Ciudad de México) resolve on both prefixes, the same way they do today.
  5. Paths that aren't cities still 404 on both prefixes.

Acceptance criteria

  • /virtual-tour-services-toronto and /360-virtual-tour-photographer-toronto both return 200 with canonical /virtual-tour-services-toronto.
  • Every city URL in the generated sitemap returns 200.
  • Every photographer profile's city link returns 200.
  • tsc, eslint, npm test and next build pass.

issues.display_title: Issue #69: Country landing pages at /virtual-tour-services-<country>, replacing /?country=, link country on profiles
issues.main_description_html:
Part of #67.

Description

Country pages only exist as the homepage with a query string (/?country=Canada), and the sitemap advertises that form. The requested URL is /virtual-tour-services-canada. The country on the photographer profile's Location row is plain text.

Requirements

  1. /virtual-tour-services-<country> renders the directory pre-filtered on that country, with its own title, description, canonical and JSON-LD, like the city landing pages.
  2. The sitemap lists /virtual-tour-services-<country> instead of /?country=<name>.
  3. /?country=<name> redirects (301/308) to /virtual-tour-services-<country>, so indexed and shared links keep working.
  4. On /photographer/[slug], the country in the Location sentence from #66 (Google Street View photographer <city>, <country>) links to /virtual-tour-services-<country>, and so does the "Photographers in " breadcrumb (it links to /?country= today).
  5. Country and city pages share the virtual-tour-services- prefix on the root [citySlug] route. When a name is both a city and a country (e.g. Singapore, Luxembourg, Monaco), the country wins (confirmed). The city page stays reachable at /360-virtual-tour-photographer-<city>, and no query-param flag is used. On 2026-09-22 there were no such collisions: none of the 169 cities that have photographers shares a name with any of the 248 countries.
  6. Non-ASCII and multi-word countries (e.g. Czech Republic, Réunion) resolve. Unknown names 404.

Acceptance criteria

  • /virtual-tour-services-canada returns 200 with the directory filtered on Canada, and /?country=Canada redirects to it.
  • Every country URL in the generated sitemap returns 200, and none of them is a ?country= URL.
  • Every photographer profile's country link returns 200.
  • tsc, eslint, npm test and next build pass.

issues.display_title: Issue #75: Country landing pages: H1 and intro text "360° Photographers & Virtual Tour Services in <country>"
issues.main_description_html:
Follow-up to #69 / #67, from albug's feedback.

Description

Country landing pages (/virtual-tour-services-<country>, #69) still show the generic homepage hero: "Find trusted 360° photographers in any corner of the world." albug asked for country-specific copy. Example for Switzerland:

<h1>360° Photographers & Virtual Tour Services in Switzerland</h1>

Find professional 360° photographers and virtual tour service providers across Switzerland. Compare specialists offering 360° photography, virtual tour creation, panorama editing, image processing, and post-production services.

Browse recently updated profiles, view each provider’s services, and find the right professional for your virtual tour or 360° imaging project in Switzerland.

Requirements

  1. On /virtual-tour-services-<country>, the H1 and the intro paragraphs use the text above with the country's name.
  2. Names that take "the" read naturally, e.g. "in the United States", "across the Netherlands", "in the Dominican Republic".
  3. The loading shell (Suspense fallback) shows the same heading, so the page never flashes the generic one.
  4. The homepage / and the city landing pages keep their current heading.

Acceptance criteria

  • /virtual-tour-services-switzerland has exactly one <h1>: "360° Photographers & Virtual Tour Services in Switzerland", followed by both paragraphs.
  • /virtual-tour-services-united-states reads "in the United States".
  • / still shows "Find trusted 360° photographers in any corner of the world."
  • tsc, eslint, npm test and next build pass.
